Current accounts and packs

The free youth account

Looking for a free youth account for your child? Join thousands of parents who have already opened a free ING Go to 18 youth account for their children aged 8 to 17.

  • Free of charge (no monthly fee)
  • Parental control via the app
  • Free card replacement (first only)
Open a free youth account

🎁 Welcome gift* deposit €50 and receive €50 extra*. For now : Open an ING Go to 18 account by 27/09, deposit €50 and receive €50 extra*.
What is a free youth account?
The first step towards financial independence

A current account that helps children learn how to manage money safely, with no monthly fees.

Designed for children and teenagers aged 8 to 17, it includes everything they need for everyday banking: a debit card, their own account, mobile payments, and access to the ING Banking app as from 8 years old.

Parents stay in control thanks to parental controls, transaction monitoring, and the ability to adjust spending and cash withdrawal limits.
What's included with this free youth account?
What makes ING Go to 18 unique?

Everything needed for everyday banking: a debit card, cash withdrawals in euros (within the SEPA zone), and secure online and in-store payments.

Modern payment solutions: Apple Pay (from age 13), Google Pay (from age 16), Wero, and contactless payments. When your child is out with friends, they can easily split expenses using the Request Money feature in the app, powered by Wero.

Completely free, with no monthly fees.

Parental controls through the app. Want to know how it works? Read on!
Parental controls through the app
How much control do parents have?

Keep track of your child’s spending. Whether it’s a purchase in a shop or an online subscription, you can see where their money is going.

Adjust limits whenever needed. Set and modify spending and cash withdrawal limits to match your child’s financial learning journey.

Manage your child’s debit card. Block, temporarily freeze, or replace your child’s card directly from your own ING Banking app. We know accidents happen, which is why the first replacement card for a lost or stolen card is free. (Each additional replacement costs €10.)

I'm already an ING customer. You can easily open an ING Go to 18 account via the ING Banking app or Home’Bank. In the ING Banking app:

1. Tap "Current Accounts" under the "Products" tab.

2. Select the "ING Go to 18" option.

3. Tap "Request your free youth account".

 

Not yet an ING customer? You can apply for the account online via this link. We'll guide you through the process step by step.

The ING Go to 18 account is exclusively held in the child's name. Only one account holder is permitted, and it is not possible to grant power of attorney on this youth account.

However, the parent has full visibility over the account via the Children Overview.

With the Children Overview feature in the ING Banking app, you can easily keep track of your minor child’s account.

From this overview, you can easily:

  • View recent transactions
  • Temporarily pauze or reactivate the debit card 
  • Manage card and payment settings
  • Transfer pocket money directly to your child's account

This gives you a simple and secure way to stay informed. 
Learn more about the Children overview feature.

With the Children Overview feature in the ING Banking app, you can keep an eye on your child’s account and banking activities.

You can:

  • Monitor recent transactions;
  • Manage card settings;
  • Adjust certain payment and withdrawal limits;
  • Temporarily block or reactivate the card.

 

This helps your child learn how to manage money responsibly, step by step.

Yes. The ING Go to 18 account includes a debit card that allows your child to pay securely in shops, make online purchases and withdraw cash from ATMs.

Contactless payments are also available. The child can use the ING Banking app as from the age of 8.
<!----><slot></slot>

If your child’s debit card is lost or stolen, you can immediately block it through the ING Banking app.

You can then easily request a replacement card. The first replacement for a lost or stolen card is free of charge.

For more information, please visit our support page on lost or stolen cards.
<!----><slot></slot>

When your child turns 18, the ING Go to 18 account is automatically converted into an ING Go pack. Your child can continue using their account and everyday banking services without interruption. The ING Go pack is free for young adults aged 18 to 25. As a result, the monthly package fee only applies from the age of 26 onwards.

From age 18, your child manages the account independently. Any parental access or control ends unless further steps are taken. Read more information for parent and child.

The campaign is open to all private individuals who are at least 18 years old, have their official residence in Belgium and whose child is not yet a (joint) account holder of an ING current account on 17/08/2026. The offer is limited to a single payment of 50 euros per account (whether it is opened in the name of one or more account holders) and per person (one person can only benefit from the offer for one account opened in their name). The amount will be paid by 15/11/2026 included into the current account thus opened. This offer cannot be combined with other ING offers for the same service. Participation in this action implies acceptance of the terms & conditions. You can consult them here, at a branch, or on our website. Customers that do not wish to participate in the action can send an email by 27/09/2026 included to optoutcampaign@ing.com or contact their local ING branch and will not receive any further communication nor will they have their transactional data processed for the purpose of this action. 

 

 

Legal information concerning the ING go to 18 Account

The ING go to 18 Account is a current account reserved exclusively for young persons under the age of 18. ING must approve the account, and it can be opend with permission from the child's parent or legal guadian. ING does not charge for managing the account or withdrawing money from ATMs in the SEPA zone (some ATM operators charge transaction fees for cash withdrawals).

The ING Go To 18 Account is automatically converted to a Pack ING Go on the day your child turns 18.

Terms and conditions of the ING go to 18 Account (regulations, rates, the Fee Information Document and additional information) are available at all ING branches, at www.ing.be or by phone on +32 2 464 60 04.

Fee is subject to change by prior notification.
